nodes.name: Document Manifest
nodes.notes:
3 financial documents.
Each flows into BOTH branches simultaneously:
- Keyword branch: BM25 sparse vectors → Pinecone sparse index
- Semantic branch: dense embeddings → Pinecone dense index

nodes.name: Code — BM25 Chunker
nodes.notes:
TRUE KEYWORD SEARCH — no embeddings used here.

What this does:
1. Splits document into 500-char chunks (100 overlap)
2. Tokenises each chunk (lowercase, strip stopwords)
3. Computes term-frequency (TF) scores
4. Maps tokens → sparse dimension indices via FNV-1a hash
5. Pads a zero-filled dense vector (384 dims) — required by Pinecone
6. Outputs Pinecone-formatted vectors in batches of 100

PRE-REQUISITE — recreate nexgen-financial-kb:
  Delete existing index, then create new with:
  Name:    nexgen-financial-kb
  Dims:    384
  Metric:  dotproduct   ← required for sparse search
  Type:    Serverless (AWS us-east-1)

Both branches share the same index.
metadata.strategy differentiates them at query time.

nodes.name: HTTP Request — Pinecone Sparse Upsert
nodes.notes:
Calls Pinecone REST API to upsert sparse vectors.
Receives batches of ≤100 vectors from the BM25 Chunker node.
Both branches share the same nexgen-financial-kb index.

SETUP (3 steps):
1. Replace the URL with your nexgen-financial-kb Host URL
   → Pinecone console → nexgen-financial-kb → Host

2. Create an n8n 'Header Auth' credential:
   → Credentials → New → Header Auth
   → Name:  Api-Key
   → Value: <your Pinecone API key>

3. Select that credential in this node's Authentication field
